name: Signal
description: Signal is a nonprofit messaging app that provides end-to-end encrypted text messaging, voice messages, and voice and video calls by default, with no ads or tracking.
best_for: Individuals, journalists, and privacy-conscious users who need fully encrypted communication with no advertising or data collection.
features: End-to-end encryption by default for every message and call, powered by the open-source Signal Protocol
Voice and video calls with international support
Group chats for families, friends, and colleagues
Photo, video, GIF, and file sharing
Encrypted sticker packs with custom sticker creation
Operated as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit funded by grants and donations, with no subscription fees

alternatives.name: Telegram
alternatives.description: A cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app focused on speed and security, supporting large groups, broadcast channels, and bots.
alternatives.best_for: Communities needing large-scale group messaging and broadcast channels

alternatives.name: Discord
alternatives.description: A voice, video, and text chat platform originally built for gaming communities and now used by many online communities.
alternatives.best_for: Communities and groups needing voice channels and public servers

tiers.name: Signal
tiers.notes: Free to use; no ads, affiliate marketers, or tracking. Supported by grants and optional donations.

cons: Signal registration requires receiving an SMS or phone call, so a phone number capable of completing registration is required.
Signal itself charges nothing, but registration SMS/calls and ongoing mobile-data usage can still incur carrier or mobile-provider charges.
